card.name: Units after dose amounts
card.fires_on: The unit of measure (mg, mL, mEq) right after a number in dosing instructions, especially a small number or the first number of a range or conversion.

modes.label: mg after a number
modes.description: The unit mg directly follows a dose figure in dosing text.

modes.label: mL or mEq after a number
modes.description: The unit mL or mEq follows a volume or concentration figure, often in parentheses.
modes.example: is 1 g, equivalent to 8.12 mEq of magnesium (2<< mL>> of the 50% solution)
